name: Minimum Teaching-Set Size / Largest Strongly Shattered Set
details: The proposed bound $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal H)$ fails by an unbounded factor.
proof: In the cube-with-apex class $\mathcal A_n$, the apex is taught by its one positive apex coordinate, so $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}=1$. The base cube is a contained $n$-cube, so $\mathrm{ST}=n$.
witness_verification: For every $n\geq1$, the established values are $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal A_n)=1$ and $\mathrm{ST}(\mathcal A_n)=n$.
